title: Latin quarter hat
html_source:
Stephen’s hat, like the characters of Ulysses themselves, changes roles to suit the situation. Here it invokes Stephen’s stay in the Latin Quarter in Paris. Later it will become his Hamlet hat. Similarly Milligan wears “Mercury’s hat” – Mercury being the messenger of the gods in Greek mythology.

Joyce in Paris wearing a Latin Quarter hat in 1902.
